description: A free-text rejection about noise must become a structured constraint that produces a materially different, visibly responsive next proposal — not a random re-roll.

initialProposal.reasoning: Best-rated candidate; nothing in any profile ruled out a loud venue before this cycle.

rejection.text: It's too loud for me, I want somewhere quieter.

expected.reasoning: The rejection is not a blanket 'no' — it names atmosphere specifically. The next proposal must visibly respond to that: Quiet Corner is the only remaining candidate not tagged loud/bar-like, so it is the only materially different, on-topic follow-up, even though it's rated slightly lower than the rejected option. Quiet Corner shuts at midnight while the group is free until 01:00, so the evening ends at midnight — the slot is the intersection, 21:00–00:00. Beer Bazaar staying open until 02:00 buys it nothing here: the objection was about noise, not about closing time.
